data.title: The Futility of Proof
data.narrative_purpose: Elena presents irrefutable evidence of the 'Phantom Directive' and her identity theft to OmniCorp leadership, only to have it clinically dismissed as a psychological break, reinforcing the system's imperviousness and her profound isolation.
data.camera_style: Static wide shot establishing isolation, then tight on Elena's face, slow push during her dialogue, quick cuts to her trembling hands on evidence (Mindhunter style clinical framing)
data.color_palette: Clinical whites, cool blues, stark grays, desaturated with high contrast
data.lighting: Harsh overhead fluorescent lighting, creating sharp shadows and glare on the polished table, illuminating Elena with a cold, unforgiving light (Roger Deakins influence)
data.visual_motif: Reflections (on table), screens (evidence), geometric patterns (room architecture)
data.music: Low, almost imperceptible drone ambient, with a subtle, rising tension
data.transition_out: Quick cuts of screen text, jarring system error sound (BLIP-BLIP-BLIP)

data.title: The System's Echo
data.narrative_purpose: Elena retreats to her apartment, utterly defeated and psychologically fractured. The constant, subtle presence of surveillance (the 'Watcher') underscores her permanent entrapment and the system's indifferent endurance.
data.emotion: Despair, profound paranoia, resignation, psychological collapse
data.camera_style: Static wide shots emphasizing the oppressive nature of her apartment, then fragmented reflections of Elena across multiple screens (Mr. Robot style). Slow zoom on her vacant stare.
data.color_palette: Muted, desaturated blues and grays, with a faint, sickly green from the screens
data.lighting: Low, ambient light from multiple screens, casting shifting, fractured shadows. Sparse, clinical lighting, perhaps a single practical lamp emphasizing her isolation.
data.music: Oppressive silence broken by a low, sustained bass pulse that mimics a heartbeat or a distant machine, almost subliminal
data.transition_in: Smash cut from jarring system error sounds and quick screen flashes
data.transition_out: Fade to black, leaving the faint electronic whisper lingering
